title: Relationship Levels That Change How Many Overdraft Items Are Chargeable on Personal Checking
content:
The number of chargeable overdraft items a Personal Checking account is taken to carry moves with the owner's premier money market balance held under Savings & Money Market Accounts, with the count of overdraft charges standing on the account, and with the card payments the owner has made under Personal Credit Cards in the last twelve months.

1. Where the owner's premier money market balance reaches the tier's relationship maintenance threshold **and** at least 4 overdraft charges stand on the account, the account is taken to carry a deep relationship allowance of 1 chargeable overdraft item.
2. Where the case above does not apply **and** either the owner's premier money market balance reaches the protection source minimum of 5000.00 **or** the owner has made at least 8 card payments in the last twelve months, the account is taken to carry a relationship allowance of 2 chargeable overdraft items.
3. Where neither case applies, no such change is made to the allowance.

The relationship maintenance threshold is the tier's own figure:

| Tier | Relationship maintenance threshold (USD) |
|---|---|
| Access Checking | not offered |
| Student Checking | not offered |
| Everyday Checking | 5000.00 |
| Interest Checking | 15000.00 |
| Premier Checking | 25000.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 250000.00 |

A tier whose threshold reads not offered has no such figure, so the first case cannot arise on it.

**Combinations of the second case (hypothetical).**

| Premier money market balance | Card payments in the last twelve months | Overdraft charges standing | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6000.00 | 2 | 3 | 2 chargeable items, the premier money market limb of the second case being met |
| 800.00 | 9 | 3 | 2 chargeable items, the card payment limb being met |
| 800.00 | 2 | 3 | No change is made |
| 6000.00 | 9 | 1 | 2 chargeable items; the first case needs at least 4 charges standing |

The second case is met by either limb alone, so both need not hold together. Equality satisfies each threshold: a premier money market balance of exactly 5000.00 reaches the protection source minimum, and exactly 8 card payments meet the card limb.
